title: Oyo Obwakabaka Bwafukamira Mu Bubonero Bwe
intro: Olugendo olw’ekitalo lulindiridde abo abagumiikiriza okugonjoola ekyama kino. Mu mpapula z’Okubikkulirwa, waaliwo omufuzi omufuzi eyandizzeemu okubumba eggwanga lyonna. Ekifaananyi kino yafuga okuva ku ntebe ey’ewala, ng’alungamizibwa obulombolombo obw’edda, okutuusa akaseera ak’enjawulo ak’amazima ag’obwakatonda lwe kakyusa omufuzi n’obwakabaka emirembe gyonna. Onoobikkula emmeeme eno ey’ekitalo emboozi yaayo ekwataganya ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo n’eby’obuziba?
clues: Nnafuga eggwanga eryali likulaakulana nga lisomoka amazzi ag’ewala, nga limanyiddwa nnyo olw’ensuku zaffe n’olubiri oluwanvu.
Obuyinza bwange bwali bwa waggulu nnyo, naye obwakabaka obunene bwajja okusomooza okubeerawo kwaffe yennyini n’engeri gye tuli.
Akanyonyi akatono kaali katambuza obubaka obw’ekitalo, era ebyewuunyo ebyaddirira byamenyaamenya endowooza zange zonna ku buyinza.
Bwe nnalaba entebe ey’obwakabaka ng’ekyusiddwa mu maaso gange, nnamanya nti tewali muntu yenna afa ayinza kuba na busobozi ng’obwo.
Nalangirira mu lwatu okugondera kwange eri Mukama Omu ow’eggulu n’ensi, nga nsuula byonna bye nnali ntwala ng’eby’omuwendo edda.
Ffe ng’eggwanga, twava ku kusinza enjuba okw’edda ne tukkiriza amazima agaakyusa buli kimu.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa Okunene
options: Okufuna obubaka obw’ekyama ng’oyita mu kinyonyi ekitali kya bulijjo
Olutalo ku magye ga Nabbi Sulayman
Emyaka amakumi asatu egy’ekyeya eky’amaanyi n’obuzibu
trial.answer: Okufuna obubaka obw’ekyama ng’oyita mu kinyonyi ekitali kya bulijjo

outcome.label: Ebinaavaamu
options: Nawasa Nabbi Sulayman ne mbeera Yerusaalemi
Twagondera Allah ne tukwatira ddala okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala
Naddayo ku ntebe yange ey’obwakabaka ne ngenda mu maaso n’okufuga nga bwe nnali nfuga
Eggwanga lyawambibwa ne liyingizibwa mu bwakabaka obulala
outcome.answer: Twagondera Allah ne tukwatira ddala okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
